mapping.summary: Supplier web portal add-on that collects PPWR packaging declarations and evidence into BC.
claims: Suppliers enter material composition per line including weight, recycled content, coating and origin
Suppliers answer the Article 5 to 12 questions including heavy metals and PFAS
Suppliers upload evidence and sign declarations as legally binding
Portal available in German and English
Declaration requests start from the packaging type, pre-filled with known materials
Supplier of the main material is suggested automatically
Portal answers are written back into BC as data, replacing reported material lines
Uploaded evidence is stored as a compliance document on the packaging type
Optional switches adopt answers as a new packaging version and run the compliance check
Reports whether a declaration came back signed and complete
